title: Quercetin: A promising therapy for diabetic encephalopathy through inhibition of hippocampal ferroptosis.
authors: Cheng, Xin; Huang, Jianhua; Li, Hongli; Zhao, Di; Liu, Zhao; Zhu, Lemei; Zhang, Zhen; Peng, Weijun
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素通过抑制海马铁死亡治疗糖尿病脑病，涉及分子对接但核心为细胞与动物实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The pathophysiology of diabetic encephalopathy (DE), a significant diabetes-related pathological complication of the central nervous system, is poorly understood. Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent regulated necrotic cell death process that mediates the development of neurodegenerative and diabetes-related lesions. Quercetin (QE) exerts anti-ferroptotic effects in various diseases. However, the roles of ferroptosis in DE and the potential anti-ferroptotic mechanisms of QE are unclear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to investigate if quercetin can ameliorate DE by inhibiting ferroptosis and to elucidate the potential anti-ferroptotic mechanisms of QE, thus providing a new perspective on the pathogenesis and prevention of DE. METHODS: The spontaneously type 2 diabetic Goto-Kakizak rats and high glucose (HG)-induced PC12 cells were used as animal and in vitro models, respectively. The Morris water maze test was performed to evaluate the cognition of rats. Pathological damage was examined using hematoxylin and eosin staining. Mitochondrial damage was assessed using transmission electron microscopy. Lipid peroxidation was evaluated by examining the levels of malondialdehyde, superoxide dismutase, and glutathione. Additionally, the contents of iron ions were quantified. Immunofluorescence and western blotting were carried out to poke the protein levels. Network pharmacology analysis was conducted to construct a protein-protein interaction network for the therapeutic targets of QE in DE. Additionally, molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay was performed to examine the target of QE. RESULTS: QE alleviated cognitive impairment, decreased lipid peroxidation and iron deposition in the hippocampus, and upregulated the Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathway. HG-induced ferroptosis in PC12 cells resulted in decreased cell viability accompanied by lipid peroxidation and iron deposition. QE mitigated HG-induced ferroptosis by upregulating the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway, which was partially suppressed upon Nrf2 inhibition. Network pharmacology analysis further indicated that the Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathway is a key target of QE. Molecular docking experiments revealed that QE binds to KEAP1 through four hydrogen bonds. Moreover, QE altered the thermostability of KEAP1. CONCLUSION: These results indicated that QE inhibits ferroptosis in the hippocampal neurons by binding to KEAP1 and subsequently upregulating the Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病脑病（diabetic encephalopathy, DE）是糖尿病相关的中枢神经系统重要病理并发症，其病理生理机制尚不清楚。铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种铁依赖性的调节性坏死细胞死亡过程，介导神经退行性和糖尿病相关病变的发展。槲皮素（quercetin, QE）在多种疾病中发挥抗铁死亡作用。然而，铁死亡在DE中的作用以及QE潜在的抗铁死亡机制尚不明确。目的：本研究旨在探讨槲皮素是否通过抑制铁死亡改善DE，并阐明QE潜在的抗铁死亡机制，从而为DE的发病机制和预防提供新视角。方法：采用自发性2型糖尿病Goto-Kakizaki大鼠和高糖（high glucose, HG）诱导的PC12细胞分别作为动物和体外模型。通过Morris水迷宫实验评估大鼠认知功能。使用苏木精-伊红染色检查病理损伤。采用透射电子显微镜评估线粒体损伤。通过检测丙二醛、超氧化物歧化酶和谷胱甘肽水平评估脂质过氧化。此外，定量铁离子含量。采用免疫荧光和蛋白质印迹法检测蛋白水平。进行网络药理学分析，构建QE在DE中治疗靶点的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络。此外，采用分子对接和细胞热位移分析检测QE的靶点。结果：QE减轻了认知障碍，降低了海马区脂质过氧化和铁沉积，并上调了Nrf2/HO-1信号通路。HG诱导的PC12细胞铁死亡导致细胞活力下降，伴随脂质过氧化和铁沉积。QE通过上调Nrf2/HO-1通路减轻HG诱导的铁死亡，而Nrf2抑制后该效应部分被抑制。网络药理学分析进一步表明，Nrf2/HO-1信号通路是QE的关键靶点。分子对接实验显示，QE通过四个氢键与KEAP1结合。此外，QE改变了KEAP1的热稳定性。结论：这些结果表明，QE通过结合KEAP1并随后上调Nrf2/HO-1信号通路，抑制海马神经元的铁死亡。
